title: Project state change event (project.state/v1)
description: One event emitted when a project's state changes. Aligned with agent.lifecycle/v1 (workflow pull request #8) by sharing the `project` join key, RFC 3339 timestamps, and scrubbed free text. This schema does not edit agent.lifecycle/v1, board.snapshot/v1, or any file under observability/.

ts.description: UTC timestamp in RFC 3339 form with second precision.

project.description: Opaque identifier. Not a URL, path, hostname, email, or secret.

previous_state.description: State before this transition. Null if this is the first recorded state.

generation.description: The state file's generation after this transition.

by.description: Who made the change, as a kind-prefixed id (for example human:owner or agent:hermes-forge). Not an email, hostname, or secret.

reason.description: Already-scrubbed free text. Must not contain secrets, keys, tokens, environment-file contents, patches, prompts, private URLs, IP addresses, or hostnames.

source.description: Which surface recorded the change. Not a hostname.

oneOf.description: Repo-relative path of the resume snapshot (usually PARKED.md). Not absolute; no empty, '.' or '..' segment anywhere (leading or interior); no backslash. Schema checks the text only: a reader must also resolve it inside the repository root, refuse any symlink component, and require a regular file (docs/18 section 5, tools/project-state/check.py).
